_comment: Real earnings dates from SEC EDGAR, keyed by ticker then Report label. Each value is 'YYYY-MM-DD|source'. Sources: 8K = the 8-K carrying item 2.02 (Results of Operations), which is the earnings release itself and the best evidence; 10Q/10K = the periodic filing date, which trails the announcement by a few days; 6K~ = a foreign issuer's 6-K matched on proximity only, because 6-Ks carry no item codes - treat those as weaker. Regenerate with scripts/fetch_earnings_dates.py.
